newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * The Romanian government held talks with leaders of the opposition Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) and National Unity Party (PUNR) on the government's medium-term reforms.
* The cabinet met to discuss increasing the health budget.

* Bucharest's city hall cannot keep its vow to offer free urban transportation for pensioners, deputy mayor Anton Vatasescu said. He said pensioners would probably get a 50 percent discount. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
